**2.5h**

I'm on to Firmware now! I had a few problems in this session, mainly with routing my PCB, where the Blue guide lines were pointing to the wrong place. It turns out J1 was flipped. Other than that it went fine and I downloaded the Arduino IDE. Didn't get my board yet but i might soon! I wish i didn't have to deal with this goal because I still have a lot to do if i want to reach my goal :( See Ya!
